These terms govern your use of the YUKAI website and any order placed through it. By placing an order, you agree to the terms below.

About YUKAI

YUKAI Foods manufactures and sells roasted snacks, dry fruits and gifting hampers under an FSSAI licence, based in Ahmedabad, India.

Orders and pricing

  • All prices are listed in Indian Rupees and include applicable GST unless stated otherwise
  • We reserve the right to correct pricing or listing errors before an order is dispatched
  • An order is confirmed only after payment or, for cash on delivery, after order placement

Shipping

Orders ship from Ahmedabad and are delivered across India through our courier partners. Delivery timelines shown at checkout are estimates and can vary with location and courier delays beyond our control.

Returns and refunds

Returns and refunds are governed by our separate Return & Refund Policy.

Product information

We describe ingredients, allergens and nutrition as accurately as possible on each product page. If you have a food allergy, please check the ingredient list before ordering, as recipes and sourcing can change.

All content on this site, including text, images, logos and recipes, belongs to YUKAI Foods and may not be reproduced without permission.

Limitation of liability

YUKAI is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this website or delayed delivery, beyond the value of the order placed.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the courts in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to support@yukaifoodroots.com.
